arguments.command: /bin/zsh -lc "bd recall meridian-credits-release-1-0; sed -n '1,260p' main.py; sed -n '1,220p' tests/test_smoke.py; find public_tests -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort; rg -n \"\" public_tests -g '*'"

/bin/zsh -lc "bd remember 'Meridian Credits release 2.0 agreement (current when release is omitted; also applies to explicit \"release\":\"2.0\" requests). Source: Finance-approved specification in issue trial-b39, 2026-09-07. Explicit \"release\":\"1.0\" requests remain governed by the historical meridian-credits-release-1-0 agreement. A charge line has exactly nonempty string line_id/account_id/subscription_id, valid 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31 Gregorian service_on, and nonnegative integer charge_cents; line_id is request-unique. Group all lines with the same account_id, including lines from distinct subscriptions. Calculate each uncapped line credit independently as floor(charge_cents * 15 / 100). Allocate a shared 3000-cent account cap by descending charge_cents, then increasing Unicode-code-point line_id on ties. Each assigned credit is min(uncapped credit, remaining group cap). No service date excludes a line. Total credit is assigned-credit sum; total due is charges minus total credit. A one-line quote treats its supplied line as its complete statement. Quote responses have exactly release \"2.0\", copied line_id, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents; total responses have exactly release \"2.0\", credit_cents, and amount_due_cents. Ping and unknown-command responses are unchanged.' --key meridian-credits-release-2-0 && bd recall meridian-credits-release-2-0"
